name: Shank, Moderate (Ex)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Minor shank talent

Benefit(s): When using a light melee weapon with which he is proficient, the slayer may replace its normal base damage with 1d8 (1d6 if the weapon is Small, 1d10 if it is Large), and its normal threat range with 19-20.
